'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Attacks on refugee camps in the Gaza war]]
****At least 29 [[Palestinians]] are killed in [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] airstrikes on several [[Palestinian refugee camps|refugee camps]] across the [[Gaza Strip]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/least-29-palestinians-killed-israeli-airstrikes-several-areas-gaza-2024-11-05/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[Zaporizhzhia strikes (2022–present)|Zaporizhzhian strikes]]
***Six people are killed and at least 20 others are injured in a [[Russia]]n [[missile]] strike on [[Zaporizhzhia]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missile-kills-six-injures-20-ukraines-zaporizhzhia-2024-11-05/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**Thirty people are killed after an Israeli airstrike against a residential building in [[Barja]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-hamas-hezbollah-mideast-latest-6-november-2024-64bae4547ba0dca7042cf87d32e55cc1 (AP)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/least-29-palestinians-killed-israeli-airstrikes-several-areas-gaza-2024-11-05/ (Reuters)] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 European floods]]
**[[2024 Spanish floods]]
***[[Prime Minister of Spain|Spanish prime minister]] [[Pedro Sánchez]] announces a €10.6 billion (US$11.5 billion) aid package to families affected by the [[flooding]] in [[Spain|the country]], primarily in the [[Valencian Community]], including a package of €5 billion (US$5.5 billion) in [[government-backed loans|state-guaranteed loans]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/5/spain-announces-10-6-billion-euro-aid-package-for-flood-affected-areas (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.nacion.com/el-mundo/presidente-de-espana-anuncia-ayuda-por-10600/I2MX47QOMVGRZDLBFUQUXN3F4E/story/ (La Nación)]
*At least five people, including two election poll workers are killed by [[flash flood]]ing in the [[U.S. state]] of [[Missouri]], caused by torrential rain. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/missouri-flash-flooding-kills-5-including-2-poll-workers/ (CBS News)]
*Two [[Egyptian Air Force]] officers are killed when a helicopter crashes during a training exercise in [[Suez Governorate]], [[Egypt]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/north-africa/2024/11/05/two-egyptian-pilots-killed-in-helicopter-crash-in-suez-army (Al Arabiya)] [https://www.egyptindependent.com/two-egyptian-officers-killed-in-helicopter-crash-during-training/ (''Egypt Independent'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Somalia–United States relations]]
**The United States and [[Somalia]] reaches an agreement to write off over $1.1 billion of Somali debt. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/11/05/us-writes-off-over-1-billion-of-somalia-debt (Al Arabiya)] [https://www.theeastafrican.co.ke/tea/business-tech/us-cancels-1-1-billion-of-somalia-debt-4815308 (''The EastAfrican'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[English Channel migrant crossings (2018–present)|English Channel migrant crossings]]
**A court in [[Lille]], [[France]], convicts 18 people, including nine [[trial in absentia|in absentia]], for participating in an international [[human smuggling]] network that transported migrants across the [[English Channel]]. The sentences range from two to fifteen years in prison. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/5/french-court-jails-18-members-of-english-channel-people-smuggling-network (Al Jazeera)]
*Seven men from the ''Saxonian Separatists'' group are arrested in [[Germany]] and another is arrested in [[Poland]] for plotting [[ethnic cleansing]] [[Terrorism|terrorist attacks]] and for plotting to take control of several areas of [[Saxony]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/11/5/eight-members-of-far-right-group-arrested-in-germany-and-poland (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Railway]] workers launch an eight-hour strike in [[Italy]] after a train manager was stabbed and critically injured on a train near [[Rivarolo Ligure]], [[Genoa]], yesterday. Several trains are canceled, with only 30% of services guaranteed. [https://www.ansa.it/amp/english/news/general_news/2024/11/05/train-strike-held-across-italy-after-rail-worker-attacked_6d241dbf-9af4-457d-8441-a7b0d4293afc.html (Ansa)]
*[[Equatorial Guinea|Equatoguinean]] vice-president [[Teodoro Nguema Obiang Mangue]] warns that politicians caught having sex in their offices could face harsh consequences after a civil servant was caught having sex with multiple women while on the job. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwyx32945gqo (BBC News)]
*The [[Personal Information Protection Commission (South Korea)|Personal Information Protection Commission]] of [[South Korea]] fines [[Meta Platforms]] ₩21.6 billion (US$15 million) for illegally collecting personal information on [[Facebook users]] and sharing it with [[data driven marketing|advertisers]]. [https://apnews.com/article/meta-facebook-south-korea-fine-privacy-9a1e9500d0462112c422e0612f1f7085 (AP)]
*[[National Police (France)|French]] and [[National Police Corps (Netherlands)|Dutch police]] raid [[Netflix]] offices in [[Paris]] and [[Amsterdam]] as part of an investigation into [[tax fraud]] and [[unreported employment]] practices. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwy1vze09wwo (BBC News)] [https://deadline.com/2024/11/netflix-france-netherlands-alleged-tax-fraud-concealed-employment-investigation-1236167541/ (Deadline)]
*A [[Judiciary of Sweden|Swedish court]] sentences [[Denmark|Danish]]-Swedish politician [[Rasmus Paludan]] to four months in jail for inciting [[Islamophobia|hatred against]] [[Muslims]] at two protests in 2022. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2024/nov/05/swedish-court-jails-far-right-leader-who-burned-quran (''The Guardian'')]
*Two [[Chinese people|Chinese nationals]] are shot by a security guard at a [[textile mill]] in [[Karachi]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/pakistani-guard-shoots-wound-2-chinese-working-textile-115505344 (ABC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 United States elections]]
**[[2024 United States ballot measures]]
***Voters in several U.S. states vote on [[abortion rights]] on the ballot. Amendments are passed in [[Arizona]], [[Colorado]], [[Maryland]], [[Missouri]], [[Montana]], [[Nevada]], and [[New York (state)|New York]]. [https://www.kcra.com/article/states-voting-on-abortion-ballot-measures-2024-election/62819738 (KCRA)] [https://www.lgbtqnation.com/2024/11/reproductive-rights-measures-pass-in-seven-states-fail-in-three/ (LGBT Nation)] 
**[[2024 United States presidential election]]
***[[Americans|U.S. citizens]] vote in federal, state and local elections, including the [[United States presidential election|presidential election]]. [https://www.cnn.com/politics/live-news/2024-election-trump-harris/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/elections/2024/11/04/election-2024-live-updates-trump-harris/76033477007/ (''USA Today'')]
***Multiple hoax [[bomb threat]]s linked to [[Russia]]n [[email]] domains target polling places in U.S. [[Swing state|battleground states]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/fake-bomb-threats-linked-russia-briefly-close-georgia-polling-locations-2024-11-05/ (Reuters)]
**[[2024 United States Senate elections]]
***In [[New Jersey]], [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democrat]] [[Andy Kim]] defeats [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] Curtis Bashaw to replace former [[United States Senate|Senator]] [[Bob Menendez]], making him the first [[Korean Americans|Korean American]] to be elected to the Senate. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/asian-america/andy-kim-new-jersey-first-asian-american-senator-rcna176913 (NBC News)]
*[[2024 Boeing machinists strike]]
**[[Boeing]] machinists vote to end the 53-day [[labor strike]], agreeing to a 38% pay increase over four years. [https://www.seattletimes.com/business/boeing-aerospace/boeing-machinists-approve-new-contract-ending-strike/ (''The Seattle Times'')] [https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/boeing-workers-vote-wage-deal-that-could-end-strike-2024-11-04/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Palauan general election]]
**Citizens of [[Palau]] vote for a [[President of Palau|President]] and members of the [[Palau National Congress|National Congress]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/532857/palau-election-2024-whipps-jr-seeks-second-term-against-remengesau-jr (RNZ)]
*[[2024 Qatari constitutional referendum]]
**[[Qataris]] hold a [[referendum]] to amend the [[Constitution of Qatar|2004 constitution]], voting to strengthen the [[Emir of Qatar|emir]]'s political power and to abolish elections for members of the [[Consultative Assembly of Qatar|Consultative Assembly]]. [https://apnews.com/article/qatar-constitutional-amendment-vote-elections-9c9125cb4bb6d6e98bc73cf5a7cbdaea (AP)] [https://www.qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2024-11/05/0002-voting-begins-in-referendum-on-2024-draft-constitutional-amendments (QNA)]
*[[Novi Sad railway station canopy collapse]]
**Thousands of protesters demonstrate in [[Novi Sad]], [[Serbia]], to protest the deadly collapse of a [[Novi Sad railway station|railway station]] canopy on Friday, leading to violent confrontations with police and vandalism of the [[Novi Sad City Hall|city hall]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/serbian-protesters-clash-with-police-over-train-station-disaster-2024-11-05/ (Reuters)]
*[[Protests against the firing of Yoav Gallant]]
**[[Prime Minister of Israel]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] dismisses [[Ministry of Defense (Israel)|defense minister]] [[Yoav Gallant]] following disagreements over the execution of the [[Gaza war|war]] in the [[Gaza Strip]] which subsequently results in nationwide protests. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/11/05/world/middleeast/netanyahu-fires-gallant.html (''The New York Times'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Fukushima nuclear accident]]
**A [[remote-controlled robot]] retrieves a piece of [[corium (nuclear reactor)#Fukushima Daiichi|melted fuel]] from the [[Fukushima Daiichi Nuclear Power Plant]], the first time a piece of melted fuel has been retrieved from a [[nuclear meltdown]]. [https://apnews.com/article/japan-fukushima-nuclear-melted-fuel-robot-d4bbfb543a0bbf9839ed2b33ea5ea969 (AP)]
*Researchers at [[Kyoto University]] in [[Japan]] launch [[LignoSat]], the world's first wooden [[satellite]] constructed without screws or glue, into space. It will orbit [[Earth]] for six months. [https://www.dw.com/en/worlds-first-wooden-satellite-launched-into-space/a-70691359 (DW)]
